description:
Logs a request for a spec that doesn't exist yet and notifies maintainers.
Call this when a user asks for a provider or capability that has no spec in the registry (check list_providers first).
This helps maintainers prioritize which specs to write next.

Args:
  - provider (string): Provider slug e.g. "wave"
  - capability (string): Capability name e.g. "create_payment"

Returns: { logged: true, count } if the request was recorded — count is the all-time number of
requests for this exact provider+capability, including this one, so you can tell the user e.g.
"you're the Nth person to ask for this". count is absent if it could not be reliably determined —
in that case do NOT guess a number to the user, just confirm the request was logged.
{ logged: false, reason } if the spec already exists.
isError if the request could not be stored: tell the user it was NOT recorded.
name: request_spec
title: Request Spec
